My idea for Middle Eastern conflicts are a large number of conflicts ~10 years after WWIII and would go until the end of the Third Mexican-American War, and would be similar to the Napoleonic Wars, where there is multiple wars between Assyria and Arabia. Although I don't have a good idea about the general prosperity of the Middle East and general politics of the Middle East during this time period, I assume that it is essentially near similar to present day. 

I have a sandbox for this, if you wish to look at it and see what I mean.
